profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company traded under the ticker APPN, with headquarters in McLean, Virginia. According to its website, it provides AI automation for business processes at large organizations, and the company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years. It describes its platform as a way to orchestrate AI agents, systems, and people from a unified platform, and to give AI reliability and control.

The site presents AI-powered process automation across a range of functions: accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing, contracts and supplier data, audit workflows and attestations, case intake and resolution, procure-to-pay, onboarding, order intake and fulfillment, and contract review and approvals. It also describes no-code app building with embedded AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. Appian states that it was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), and it points to an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services. It claims onboarding work can be cut by up to 50%.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded in Virginia, with 152 cases. No lawsuits, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are listed for it.
